name: Anatomical Lessons with Dr.Avner!
source:
In the distant future, criminals are redefined as objects based on the severity of their crimes, turning their punishment into a capitalist opportunity. Rage rooms are created where people pay to torture these criminals, and live streams of these events become a form of entertainment for those who can't attend in person.

[From [url=https://ilovemyzombiegf.itch.io/anatomical-lessons-with-dravner]itch.io[/url]]
